examined_formations.title: CROSS_BORDER_CHINA_GROUND_TRUTH_EXECUTION_ROUTING
examined_formations.chinese_title: 跨境中国本地实地核验 / 取证 / 执行路由
examined_formations.evidence_summary: Current overseas buyers are paying fixed-price China-local evidence tasks across retail shelf surveys, predefined site audits, showroom capture and factory verification. China-side crowdsourcing already standardizes city/task/checklist/photo evidence/QA, while Upwork can pre-fund fixed-price milestones. Raw price-cost headroom exists for selected nontechnical task classes, but generic China-local execution already has exact/near-exact incumbents (ChinaLocalAgent, Upwork marketplace, WeiChaiShi), Upwork subcontracting requires client consent, and founder-free acquisition plus fully normalized travel/QA/rework economics remain unproven.
observed_demand_and_payment: Shanghai wine-shop field survey pays USD25 per satisfactory visited shop across 21 shops.
Chengdu predefined nontechnical test-center audit pays USD100 for one visit, photos and predefined report.
Guangzhou/Foshan showroom capture pays USD100 for a trial visit and explicitly offers monthly repeat if accepted.
China factory production verification pays USD200 but requires factory/production judgement and is not treated as a generic first-bootstrap task.
USD4 GPS-photo site visits exist as a negative control and fail the public China-side basic-photo executor floor before fees.
supply_and_standardization: Existing Scan 126 seed records a China-side field network with task decomposition, location/time/photo requirements, local matching, evidence QA and public worker payout references of RMB30-80 for basic photos and RMB80-200 for short-video/multi-point tasks.
WeiChaiShi publicly offers nationwide crowdsourced data collection, market research and retail audit across 500+ cities with quality checking.

UU Paotui publicly exposes MCP/CLI/Agent Skill/OpenAPI for quote/order/status/cancel/track physical errand primitives, but evidence-capture semantics are not proven through that machine-callable rail.
payment_and_authorization: Upwork fixed-price work can require a funded milestone before work begins.
Upwork explicitly requires client consent before an individual freelancer subcontracts any agreed work; agency structure is a transparent alternative.
Therefore hidden subcontracting is forbidden and cannot be used to claim a callable dispatch rail.
price_cost_signal: FX snapshot used for this research: 1 USD approximately RMB6.701.

USD100 predefined site-audit buyer budget creates large same-family screening headroom, but the buyer scope includes facility observation, staff interaction and an English predefined report; a same-scope local executor quote is still required before margin inference.

USD25 retail-shop budget leaves approximately RMB142.4 after a 15% freelancer fee; against RMB30-80 basic-photo payout, raw headroom is approximately RMB62.4 at the high payout bound before travel/QA/rework.
USD4 site-visit budget leaves approximately RMB22.8 after a 15% freelancer fee, below the RMB30 basic-photo payout floor before travel; reject.
exact_incumbent_and_control_surface_pref: ChinaLocalAgent currently offers almost the same overseas-client -> scoped China local execution -> photo/video/checklist/report flow, with quote-before-work and permission/privacy review.
Upwork itself already owns global buyer discovery, fixed-price funding and direct China freelancer matching for these tasks.
WeiChaiShi already owns a nationwide China crowdsourcing/QA control surface for retail audits and field data collection.

The broad generic 'China helper / local execution' layer therefore cannot be presumed white space. The remaining possible edge, if any, must be narrower: machine-native cross-border scope normalization + lawful dispatch + standardized evidence acceptance across replaceable local rails.
decisive_unknowns: Does any current incumbent already provide the same low-volume cross-border self-service/machine-native scope-normalize-dispatch-evidence-acceptance loop?
Can a transparent, authorized subcontract/agency path preserve prepaid buyer funds before local execution cost?
Can travel, QA and rework be bounded tightly enough that contribution margin remains positive for the selected nontechnical task classes?
Can later customer acquisition escape recurring founder proposal-writing and persuasion?
Can domestic machine-callable/crowd rails accept evidence-specific briefs rather than only delivery/errand primitives?
exact_incumbent_preflight_result: ChinaLocalAgent already sells overseas-client defined China-local execution with evidence and reporting.
Upwork already owns self-revealing buyer demand, funded fixed-price payment and direct China talent matching.
WeiChaiShi already owns nationwide replaceable crowd dispatch, retail/field tasking, QA, approval and payment.
Premise demonstrates the generalized global local-task/photo/geolocation/QA/data-delivery mechanism at scale.
UU Paotui shows machine-callable physical action is becoming a native platform primitive.
